description: A small, soft, lopsided creature with three little paddle feet, two leaf-like feelers and large curious eyes.
silhouette: One continuous pear-shaped body; a broad soft base and a tiny off-centre crown.
mannerisms: A soft three-footed shuffle when moving.
A listening feeler that inclines toward something interesting.
A slight whole-body tilt while watching birds.
An occasional slow blink; a small settled shape while resting.
